On Mon, Sep 24, 2012 at 11:21 PM, <tob...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Matt

Thanks for your last email.
Now that rstan is out, I played with it, but I am not completely happy. I tried stan with a simple variance components model, very similar to the Dyes bugs example (that is also in the stan download file). It is the between group variance component that I expected, with stan, to be better estimated by a better mixing chain for this parameter, compared to the known bad mixing of that parameter in bugs/jags/ordinary gibbs. Maybe I did something wrong (and I did not run the Dyes example), but if you have a thought on this, I would very much appreciate sharing.

Here, 2 implementations, one with untransformed between and within variance and inv_gamma priors, and the other with using the precision (1/sig) and gamma priors.
http://pastebin.com/FwHrXuUB

Thanks
Toby
